chapter_title: The Human Eye and the Colourful World

question_papers.paper_title: Set 1 - The Human Eye and the Colourful World Practice Paper

questions.question_text: Which visual defect causes a person to see near objects clearly but struggle with distant objects?
options: Hypermetropia
Myopia
Presbyopia
Cataract
questions.correct_answer: Myopia

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements correctly describes key observations in The Human Eye and the Colourful World (Set 1)?
options: Core process in The Human Eye and the Colourful World obeys conservation laws and standard reaction conditions.
Process in The Human Eye and the Colourful World violates mass conservation.
No physical or chemical state change occurs during the reaction.
Products have higher total mass than initial reactants.
questions.correct_answer: Core process in The Human Eye and the Colourful World obeys conservation laws and standard reaction conditions.

questions.question_text: What physical state symbol or indicator color change is associated with The Human Eye and the Colourful World (Set 1)?
options: Aqueous solution (aq) with characteristic color change
Solid precipitate (s) with gas emission
Gaseous phase (g) only
Liquid phase (l) with zero temperature change
questions.correct_answer: Aqueous solution (aq) with characteristic color change

questions.question_text: Identify the correct SI unit or mathematical relationship relevant to The Human Eye and the Colourful World (Set 1).
options: Standard NCERT Formula & Unit
Dimensionless Ratio x 100
Inverse Square Exponential
Absolute Constant Zero
questions.correct_answer: Standard NCERT Formula & Unit

questions.question_text:
Assertion (A): Fundamental processes in The Human Eye and the Colourful World strictly follow thermodynamic and chemical principles.
Reason (R): Molecular and atomic rearrangements preserve total mass, charge, and energy balance.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.correct_answer: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

question_papers.paper_title: Set 4 - The Human Eye and the Colourful World Practice Paper

questions.question_text: Explain the optical mechanism responsible for advanced sunrise and delayed sunset.
options: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D
questions.correct_answer: Light rays from the sun below the horizon pass through atmospheric air layers of increasing density, bending downward by atmospheric refraction so the sun appears ~2 minutes earlier.

Option B
Option C
Option D
